verses.original: יְהוָ֔ה וַיֵּרָ֤א אֵלָיו֙ בְּאֵלֹנֵ֖י מַמְרֵ֑א כְּחֹ֥ם הַיּֽוֹם׃ וְה֛וּא יֹשֵׁ֥ב פֶּֽתַח־ הָאֹ֖הֶל
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yê·rā ’ê·lāw bə·’ê·lō·nê mam·rê kə·ḥōm hay·yō·wm wə·hū yō·šêḇ pe·ṯaḥ- hā·’ō·hel
verses.literal: Then the LORD appeared to [Abraham] by the Oaks of Mamre in the heat of the day while he was sitting at the entrance of his tent

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂ֤א עֵינָיו֙ וַיַּ֔רְא וְהִנֵּה֙ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה אֲנָשִׁ֔ים נִצָּבִ֖ים עָלָ֑יו וַיַּ֗רְא וַיָּ֤רָץ מִפֶּ֣תַח הָאֹ֔הֶל לִקְרָאתָם֙ וַיִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ אָֽרְצָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·śā ‘ê·nāw way·yar wə·hin·nêh šə·lō·šāh ’ă·nā·šîm niṣ·ṣā·ḇîm ‘ā·lāw way·yar way·yā·rāṣ mip·pe·ṯaḥ hā·’ō·hel liq·rā·ṯām way·yiš·ta·ḥū ’ā·rə·ṣāh
verses.literal: And [Abraham] looked up . . . and saw . . . three men standing nearby When he saw them he ran from the entrance of his tent to meet them and bowed low to the ground

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֗י וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אִם־ מָצָ֤אתִי חֵן֙ בְּעֵינֶ֔יךָ נָ֨א אַל־ נָ֥א תַעֲבֹ֖ר מֵעַ֥ל עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḏō·nāy way·yō·mar ’im- mā·ṣā·ṯî ḥên bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā nā ’al- nā ṯa·‘ă·ḇōr mê·‘al ‘aḇ·de·ḵā
verses.literal: My lord said [Abraham] if I have found favor in your sight please do not . . . pass . . . your servant {by}

verses.original: מְעַט־ מַ֔יִם יֻקַּֽח־ נָ֣א וְרַחֲצ֖וּ רַגְלֵיכֶ֑ם וְהִֽשָּׁעֲנ֖וּ תַּ֥חַת הָעֵֽץ׃
verses.transliteration: mə·‘aṭ- ma·yim yuq·qaḥ- nā wə·ra·ḥă·ṣū raḡ·lê·ḵem wə·hiš·šā·‘ă·nū ta·ḥaṯ hā·‘êṣ
verses.literal: Let a little water be brought . . . that you may wash your feet and rest yourselves under the tree

verses.original: וְאֶקְחָ֨ה פַת־ לֶ֜חֶם וְסַעֲד֤וּ לִבְּכֶם֙ כִּֽי־ עַל־ כֵּ֥ן תַּעֲבֹ֔רוּ עַבְדְּכֶ֑ם אַחַ֣ר עֲבַרְתֶּ֖ם עַֽל־ כֵּ֥ן וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּֽרְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eq·ḥāh p̄aṯ- le·ḥem wə·sa·‘ă·ḏū lib·bə·ḵem kî- ‘al- kên ta·‘ă·ḇō·rū ‘aḇ·də·ḵem ’a·ḥar ‘ă·ḇar·tem ‘al- kên way·yō·mə·rū ta·‘ă·śeh ka·’ă·šer dib·bar·tā
verses.literal: And I will bring a bit of bread so that you may refresh yourselves This is why . . . . . . you have passed your servant’s way After that you may continue on your way . . . Yes they replied you may do as you have said

verses.original: אַבְרָהָ֛ם וַיְמַהֵ֧ר הָאֹ֖הֱלָה וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אֶל־ שָׂרָ֑ה מַהֲרִ֞י שְׁלֹ֤שׁ סְאִים֙ סֹ֔לֶת קֶ֣מַח ל֖וּשִׁי וַעֲשִׂ֥י עֻגֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḇ·rā·hām way·ma·hêr hā·’ō·hĕ·lāh way·yō·mer ’el- śā·rāh ma·hă·rî šə·lōš sə·’îm sō·leṯ qe·maḥ lū·šî wa·‘ă·śî ‘u·ḡō·wṯ
verses.literal: So Abraham hurried into the tent and said to Sarah Quick! Prepare three seahs of fine flour knead it and bake some bread

verses.original: אַבְרָהָ֑ם רָ֣ץ וְאֶל־ הַבָּקָ֖ר וַיִּקַּ֨ח רַ֤ךְ וָטוֹב֙ בֶּן־ בָּקָ֜ר וַיִּתֵּ֣ן אֶל־ הַנַּ֔עַר וַיְמַהֵ֖ר לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḇ·rā·hām rāṣ wə·’el- hab·bā·qār way·yiq·qaḥ raḵ wā·ṭō·wḇ ben- bā·qār way·yit·tên ’el- han·na·‘ar way·ma·hêr la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: Meanwhile, Abraham ran to the herd selected a tender and choice calf . . . and gave it to a servant who hurried to prepare it

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח חֶמְאָ֜ה וְחָלָ֗ב וּבֶן־ הַבָּקָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וַיִּתֵּ֖ן לִפְנֵיהֶ֑ם וְהֽוּא־ עֹמֵ֧ד עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם תַּ֥חַת הָעֵ֖ץ וַיֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ḥem·’āh wə·ḥā·lāḇ ū·ḇen- hab·bā·qār ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh way·yit·tên lip̄·nê·hem wə·hū- ‘ō·mêḏ ‘ă·lê·hem ta·ḥaṯ hā·‘êṣ way·yō·ḵê·lū
verses.literal: Then Abraham brought curds and milk and the calf . . . that had been prepared and he set them before the men and stood by them under the tree as they ate

verses.original: אַיֵּ֖ה אִשְׁתֶּ֑ךָ שָׂרָ֣ה וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵׄלָׄ֔יׄוׄ הִנֵּ֥ה בָאֹֽהֶל׃ וַיֹּ֖אמֶר
verses.transliteration: ’ay·yêh ’iš·te·ḵā śā·rāh way·yō·mə·rū ʾē·lå̄w hin·nêh ḇā·’ō·hel way·yō·mer
verses.literal: Where is your wife Sarah they asked . . . There in the tent he replied

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר שׁ֣וֹב אָשׁ֤וּב אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ כָּעֵ֣ת חַיָּ֔ה וְהִנֵּה־ אִשְׁתֶּ֑ךָ לְשָׂרָ֣ה בֵ֖ן וְשָׂרָ֥ה וְה֥וּא אַחֲרָֽיו׃ שֹׁמַ֛עַת פֶּ֥תַח הָאֹ֖הֶל
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šō·wḇ ’ā·šūḇ ’ê·le·ḵā kā·‘êṯ ḥay·yāh wə·hin·nêh- ’iš·te·ḵā lə·śā·rāh ḇên wə·śā·rāh wə·hū ’a·ḥă·rāw šō·ma·‘aṯ pe·ṯaḥ hā·’ō·hel
verses.literal: Then the LORD said I will surely return . . . to you at this time next year . . . . . . and your wife Sarah will have a son Now Sarah . . . was behind him listening at the entrance to the tent

verses.original: וְאַבְרָהָ֤ם וְשָׂרָה֙ זְקֵנִ֔ים בָּאִ֖ים בַּיָּמִ֑ים לְשָׂרָ֔ה חָדַל֙ לִהְי֣וֹת אֹ֖רַח כַּנָּשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’aḇ·rā·hām wə·śā·rāh zə·qê·nîm bā·’îm bay·yā·mîm lə·śā·rāh ḥā·ḏal lih·yō·wṯ ’ō·raḥ kan·nā·šîm
verses.literal: And Abraham and Sarah were already old and well along in years Sarah had passed . . . the age of childbearing . . .

verses.original: שָׂרָ֖ה וַתִּצְחַ֥ק בְּקִרְבָּ֣הּ לֵאמֹ֑ר אַחֲרֵ֤י בְלֹתִי֙ וַֽאדֹנִ֖י זָקֵֽן׃ הָֽיְתָה־ לִּ֣י עֶדְנָ֔ה
verses.transliteration: śā·rāh wat·tiṣ·ḥaq bə·qir·bāh lê·mōr ’a·ḥă·rê ḇə·lō·ṯî wa·ḏō·nî zā·qên hā·yə·ṯāh- lî ‘eḏ·nāh
verses.literal: So [she] laughed to herself saying After I am worn out and my master is old will I now have . . . this pleasure

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אַבְרָהָ֑ם לָ֣מָּה זֶּה֩ שָׂרָ֜ה צָחֲקָ֨ה לֵאמֹ֗ר הַאַ֥ף אֻמְנָ֛ם אֵלֵ֖ד וַאֲנִ֥י זָקַֽנְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’el- way·yō·mer ’aḇ·rā·hām lām·māh zeh śā·rāh ṣā·ḥă·qāh lê·mōr ha·’ap̄ ’um·nām ’ê·lêḏ wa·’ă·nî zā·qan·tî
verses.literal: And the LORD . . . asked Abraham Why . . . did Sarah laugh and say Can I really . . . bear a child when I am old

verses.original: דָּבָ֑ר הֲיִפָּלֵ֥א מֵיְהוָ֖ה לַמּוֹעֵ֞ד אָשׁ֥וּב אֵלֶ֛יךָ כָּעֵ֥ת חַיָּ֖ה וּלְשָׂרָ֥ה בֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: dā·ḇār hă·yip·pā·lê Yah·weh lam·mō·w·‘êḏ ’ā·šūḇ ’ê·le·ḵā kā·‘êṯ ḥay·yāh ū·lə·śā·rāh ḇên
verses.literal: Is anything too difficult for the LORD At the appointed time I will return to you in about a year . . . and Sarah will have a son

verses.original: שָׂרָ֧ה׀ יָרֵ֑אָה כִּ֣י׀ וַתְּכַחֵ֨שׁ לֵאמֹ֛ר לֹ֥א צָחַ֖קְתִּי לֹ֖א וַיֹּ֥אמֶר׀ כִּ֥י צָחָֽקְתְּ׃
verses.transliteration: śā·rāh yā·rê·’āh kî wat·tə·ḵa·ḥêš lê·mōr lō ṣā·ḥaq·tî lō way·yō·mer kî ṣā·ḥā·qət
verses.literal: But Sarah was afraid so she denied it and said “I did not laugh No replied [the LORD] but you did laugh

verses.original: וַיָּקֻ֤מוּ מִשָּׁם֙ הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים וַיַּשְׁקִ֖פוּ עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י סְדֹ֑ם וְאַ֨בְרָהָ֔ם הֹלֵ֥ךְ עִמָּ֖ם לְשַׁלְּחָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qu·mū miš·šām hā·’ă·nā·šîm way·yaš·qi·p̄ū ‘al- pə·nê sə·ḏōm wə·’aḇ·rā·hām hō·lêḵ ‘im·mām lə·šal·lə·ḥām
verses.literal: When [the men] got up to leave [they] looked out over . . . Sodom and Abraham walked along with them to see them off

verses.original: וַֽיהֹוָ֖ה אָמָ֑ר אֲנִי֙ הַֽמְכַסֶּ֤ה מֵֽאַבְרָהָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֲנִ֥י עֹשֶֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ā·mār ’ă·nî ham·ḵas·seh mê·’aḇ·rā·hām ’ă·šer ’ă·nî ‘ō·śeh
verses.literal: And the LORD said Shall I hide from Abraham what I am about to do

verses.original: וְאַ֨בְרָהָ֔ם הָי֧וֹ יִֽהְיֶ֛ה גָּד֖וֹל וְעָצ֑וּם לְג֥וֹי ב֔וֹ כֹּ֖ל גּוֹיֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃ וְנִ֨בְרְכוּ
verses.transliteration: wə·’aḇ·rā·hām hā·yōw yih·yeh gā·ḏō·wl wə·‘ā·ṣūm lə·ḡō·w ḇōw kōl gō·w·yê hā·’ā·reṣ wə·niḇ·rə·ḵū
verses.literal: Abraham will surely become . . . a great and powerful nation and through him all the nations of the earth {will} be blessed

verses.original: כִּ֣י יְדַעְתִּ֗יו לְמַעַן֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְצַוֶּ֜ה אֶת־ בָּנָ֤יו וְאֶת־ בֵּיתוֹ֙ אַחֲרָ֔יו וְשָֽׁמְרוּ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יְהוָ֔ה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת צְדָקָ֖ה וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט לְמַ֗עַן יְהוָה֙ הָבִ֤יא עַל־ אַבְרָהָ֔ם אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֖ר עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: kî yə·ḏa‘·tîw lə·ma·‘an ’ă·šer yə·ṣaw·weh ’eṯ- bā·nāw wə·’eṯ- bê·ṯōw ’a·ḥă·rāw wə·šā·mə·rū de·reḵ Yah·weh la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ṣə·ḏā·qāh ū·miš·pāṭ lə·ma·‘an Yah·weh hā·ḇî ‘al- ’aḇ·rā·hām ’êṯ ’ă·šer- dib·ber ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: For I have chosen him so that he will command - his children and his household after him to keep the way of the LORD by doing what is right and just in order that the LORD may bring upon Abraham - what He has promised -

verses.original: יְהוָ֔ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר זַעֲקַ֛ת סְדֹ֥ם וַעֲמֹרָ֖ה רָ֑בָּה כִּי־ וְחַ֨טָּאתָ֔ם כִּ֥י מְאֹֽד׃ כָבְדָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer za·‘ă·qaṯ sə·ḏōm wa·‘ă·mō·rāh rāb·bāh kî- wə·ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯām kî mə·’ōḏ ḵā·ḇə·ḏāh
verses.literal: Then the LORD said The outcry against Sodom and Gomorrah is great Because their sin - is so grievous

verses.original: אֵֽרֲדָה־ נָּ֣א וְאֶרְאֶ֔ה עָשׂ֣וּ׀ כָּלָ֑ה הַכְּצַעֲקָתָ֛הּ הַבָּ֥אָה אֵלַ֖י וְאִם־ לֹ֖א אֵדָֽעָה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ê·ră·ḏāh- nā wə·’er·’eh ‘ā·śū kā·lāh hak·kə·ṣa·‘ă·qā·ṯāh hab·bā·’āh ’ê·lay wə·’im- lō ’ê·ḏā·‘āh
verses.literal: I will go down . . . to see if their actions fully justify the outcry that has reached Me If not I will find out

verses.original: הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים וַיִּפְנ֤וּ מִשָּׁם֙ וַיֵּלְכ֖וּ סְדֹ֑מָה וְאַ֨בְרָהָ֔ם עוֹדֶ֥נּוּ עֹמֵ֖ד לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’ă·nā·šîm way·yip̄·nū miš·šām way·yê·lə·ḵū sə·ḏō·māh wə·’aḇ·rā·hām ‘ō·w·ḏen·nū ‘ō·mêḏ lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: And the [two] men turned away and went toward Sodom but Abraham remained standing before the LORD

verses.original: אַבְרָהָ֖ם וַיִּגַּ֥שׁ וַיֹּאמַ֑ר הַאַ֣ף תִּסְפֶּ֔ה צַדִּ֖יק עִם־ רָשָֽׁע׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḇ·rā·hām way·yig·gaš way·yō·mar ha·’ap̄ tis·peh ṣad·dîq ‘im- rā·šā‘
verses.literal: Abraham stepped forward and said Will You really sweep away the righteous with the wicked

verses.original: אוּלַ֥י יֵ֛שׁ חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים צַדִּיקִ֖ם בְּת֣וֹךְ הָעִ֑יר הַאַ֤ף תִּסְפֶּה֙ וְלֹא־ תִשָּׂ֣א לַמָּק֔וֹם לְמַ֛עַן חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים הַצַּדִּיקִ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּקִרְבָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ū·lay yêš ḥă·miš·šîm ṣad·dî·qim bə·ṯō·wḵ hā·‘îr ha·’ap̄ tis·peh wə·lō- ṯiś·śā lam·mā·qō·wm lə·ma·‘an ḥă·miš·šîm haṣ·ṣad·dî·qim ’ă·šer bə·qir·bāh
verses.literal: What if there are fifty righteous ones in the city Will You really sweep it away and not spare the place for the sake of the fifty righteous ones who are there

verses.original: חָלִ֨לָה לְּךָ֜ מֵעֲשֹׂ֣ת׀ הַזֶּ֗ה כַּדָּבָ֣ר לְהָמִ֤ית צַדִּיק֙ עִם־ רָשָׁ֔ע כַצַּדִּ֖יק כָּרָשָׁ֑ע וְהָיָ֥ה חָלִ֣לָה לָּ֔ךְ לֹ֥א הֲשֹׁפֵט֙ כָּל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·li·lāh lə·ḵā mê·‘ă·śōṯ haz·zeh kad·dā·ḇār lə·hā·mîṯ ṣad·dîq ‘im- rā·šā‘ ḵaṣ·ṣad·dîq kā·rā·šā‘ wə·hā·yāh ḥā·li·lāh lāḵ lō hă·šō·p̄êṭ kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ ya·‘ă·śeh miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: Far be it from You to do such a thing to kill the righteous with the wicked so that the righteous and the wicked are treated alike Far be it from You Will not the Judge of all the earth do what is right

verses.original: יְהוָ֔ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אִם־ אֶמְצָ֥א חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים צַדִּיקִ֖ם בְּת֣וֹךְ הָעִ֑יר בִסְדֹ֛ם בַּעֲבוּרָֽם׃ וְנָשָׂ֥אתִי לְכָל־ הַמָּק֖וֹם
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’im- ’em·ṣā ḥă·miš·šîm ṣad·dî·qim bə·ṯō·wḵ hā·‘îr ḇis·ḏōm ba·‘ă·ḇū·rām wə·nā·śā·ṯî lə·ḵāl ham·mā·qō·wm
verses.literal: So the LORD replied If I find fifty righteous ones within the city of Sodom on their account I will spare the whole place

verses.original: אַבְרָהָ֖ם וַיֹּאמַ֑ר וַיַּ֥עַן הִנֵּה־ נָ֤א הוֹאַ֙לְתִּי֙ לְדַבֵּ֣ר אֶל־ אֲדֹנָ֔י וְאָנֹכִ֖י עָפָ֥ר וָאֵֽפֶר׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḇ·rā·hām way·yō·mar way·ya·‘an hin·nêh- nā hō·w·’al·tî lə·ḏab·bêr ’el- ’ă·ḏō·nāy wə·’ā·nō·ḵî ‘ā·p̄ār wā·’ê·p̄er
verses.literal: Then Abraham vvv answered Now that . . . I have ventured to speak to the Lord though I am but dust and ashes

verses.original: א֠וּלַי חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים הַצַּדִּיקִם֙ יַחְסְר֞וּן חֲמִשָּׁ֔ה הֲתַשְׁחִ֥ית כָּל־ הָעִ֑יר בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֖ה אֶת־ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אִם־ אֶמְצָ֣א אַרְבָּעִ֖ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ שָׁ֔ם לֹ֣א אַשְׁחִ֔ית
verses.transliteration: ’ū·lay ḥă·miš·šîm haṣ·ṣad·dî·qim yaḥ·sə·rūn ḥă·miš·šāh hă·ṯaš·ḥîṯ kāl- hā·‘îr ba·ḥă·miš·šāh ’eṯ- way·yō·mer ’im- ’em·ṣā ’ar·bā·‘îm wa·ḥă·miš·šāh šām lō ’aš·ḥîṯ
verses.literal: suppose the fifty righteous ones lack five Will You destroy the whole city for the lack of five - He replied If I find forty-five . . . there I will not destroy [it]

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨סֶף ע֜וֹד לְדַבֵּ֤ר אֵלָיו֙ אוּלַ֛י אַרְבָּעִ֑ים וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ יִמָּצְא֥וּן שָׁ֖ם וַיֹּאמַ֔ר בַּעֲב֖וּר הָאַרְבָּעִֽים׃ לֹ֣א אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֔ה
verses.transliteration: way·yō·sep̄ ‘ō·wḏ lə·ḏab·bêr ’ê·lāw ’ū·lay ’ar·bā·‘îm way·yō·mer yim·mā·ṣə·’ūn šām way·yō·mar ba·‘ă·ḇūr hā·’ar·bā·‘îm lō ’e·‘ĕ·śeh
verses.literal: Once again . . . [Abraham] spoke to [the LORD] Suppose forty . . . are found there He answered On account of the forty I will not do it

verses.original: וַ֠יֹּאמֶר לַֽאדֹנָי֙ אַל־ נָ֞א יִ֤חַר וַאֲדַבֵּ֔רָה אוּלַ֛י שְׁלֹשִׁ֑ים יִמָּצְא֥וּן שָׁ֖ם וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אִם־ אֶמְצָ֥א שְׁלֹשִֽׁים׃ שָׁ֖ם לֹ֣א אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֔ה
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer la·ḏō·nāy ’al- nā yi·ḥar wa·’ă·ḏab·bê·rāh ’ū·lay šə·lō·šîm yim·mā·ṣə·’ūn šām way·yō·mer ’im- ’em·ṣā šə·lō·šîm šām lō ’e·‘ĕ·śeh
verses.literal: Then [Abraham] said May the Lord not . . . be angry but let me speak [further] Suppose thirty are found there He replied If I find thirty there I will not do it

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הִנֵּֽה־ נָ֤א הוֹאַ֙לְתִּי֙ לְדַבֵּ֣ר אֶל־ אֲדֹנָ֔י אוּלַ֛י עֶשְׂרִ֑ים יִמָּצְא֥וּן שָׁ֖ם וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ בַּעֲב֖וּר הָֽעֶשְׂרִֽים׃ לֹ֣א אַשְׁחִ֔ית
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hin·nêh- nā hō·w·’al·tî lə·ḏab·bêr ’el- ’ă·ḏō·nāy ’ū·lay ‘eś·rîm yim·mā·ṣə·’ūn šām way·yō·mer ba·‘ă·ḇūr hā·‘eś·rîm lō ’aš·ḥîṯ
verses.literal: And [Abraham] said Now that . . . I have ventured to speak to the Lord suppose twenty are found there He answered On account of the twenty I will not destroy [it]

verses.original: וַ֠יֹּאמֶר לַֽאדֹנָי֙ אַל־ נָ֞א יִ֤חַר וַאֲדַבְּרָ֣ה אַךְ־ הַפַּ֔עַם אוּלַ֛י עֲשָׂרָ֑ה יִמָּצְא֥וּן שָׁ֖ם וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ בַּעֲב֖וּר הָעֲשָׂרָֽה׃ לֹ֣א אַשְׁחִ֔ית
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer la·ḏō·nāy ’al- nā yi·ḥar wa·’ă·ḏab·bə·rāh ’aḵ- hap·pa·‘am ’ū·lay ‘ă·śā·rāh yim·mā·ṣə·’ūn šām way·yō·mer ba·‘ă·ḇūr hā·‘ă·śā·rāh lō ’aš·ḥîṯ
verses.literal: Finally, [Abraham] said May the Lord not . . . be angry but let me speak . . . once more Suppose ten are found there And He answered On account of the ten I will not destroy [it]

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה כִּלָּ֔ה לְדַבֵּ֖ר אֶל־ אַבְרָהָ֑ם וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ וְאַבְרָהָ֖ם שָׁ֥ב לִמְקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer Yah·weh kil·lāh lə·ḏab·bêr ’el- ’aḇ·rā·hām way·yê·leḵ wə·’aḇ·rā·hām šāḇ lim·qō·mōw
verses.literal: When the LORD had finished speaking with Abraham He departed and Abraham returned home
